scope: fixed light-on and physical-buffered platform; old off/on FAIL retained, not new global gate

hard.native: same-call pre-read contract, input/history/continuous replay existing1e-4 and1e-5 single; no unexplained reset/loss
hard.motor: original filter replay1e-9; consumer age<=8ms, cycle p99<=2500us
hard.physics: body and4rotors complete1/dropped0/errors0; full task valid; unique physical step/phase; original motor same step exact<=1e-12

decisions.scientific: count and retain failure/NOT_REACHED, does not stop reliable platform
decisions.offon: optional diagnostics only, no nonsignificance equivalence claim
